:steamhappy:
🦭

Supports ALL DEVICES (FRIDGE TOO)

CONTROLS (PC):
Left Click - punch
R - special ability
Q - dash / (ragdolled) evade / (hit) burst
3 M1s + Dash - Wall Combo
Double Tap W - sprint
G - awaken / toggle awakening moveset

Combat based off battlegrounds
Destruction inspired by Jujutsu Shenanigans / Teardown
